The '''DV4 maintenance droid''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] which resembled a slightly taller and thinner [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. A DV4 unit was assigned to the droid repair shop in the [[Hyperbaride/Legends|Hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
